pages.text: $(#8B0000)☠ Feast of the Damned · Forbidden Sacrament 💀$()$(br2)$(l)$(#4B0082)「Offer flesh and blood, and demand power from the abyss」$()$(br)When the venom of $(#8B0000)Wither Rose$() seeps into $(#696969)Bone Remnants$(), and $(#800000)Rotten Flesh$() and $(#006400)Spider Eye$() boil within the $(#483D8B)Cursed Cauldron$()—the ultimate infernal concoction, capable of $(l)granting mortals the power of demons$(), reaches its final form.

$(#8B0000)▌ Abyssal Pact $()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF0000)💢 Berserker’s Blood$()$(br)Muscle fibers rupture, unleashing $(#8B0000)inhuman strength$().$(br2)$(l)$(#DAA520)🛡 Bone Armor$()$(br)Skin hardens into $(#808080)steel-like keratin$().$(br2)$(l)$(#00FF00)👣 Shadow Stride$()$(br2)$(#4B0082)☠ Mark of the Price $()$(br)$(l)$(#556B2F)🍂 Flesh Decay$()$(br)Life force drains away like an $(#8B0000)hourglass$().$(br2)$(l)$(#8B4513)🍖 Endless Hunger$()$(br)The stomach becomes a $(#000000)bottomless void$() that can never be filled.

$(br2)$(#696969)▌ Infernal Crafting Process $()$(br)- Heat $(#8B0000)Wither Tea Extract$() until it boils into a $(#FF0000)frothing blood-red liquid$().$(br)- Add $(#696969)？:？$() proportions of $(#800000)Rotten Flesh Chunks$() and $(#006400)Spider Eyes$().$(br)- When adding $(#FFFFFF)Bone Powder$(), hold your breath.$(br2)$(#FF4500)⚡$() If $(#7CFC00)emerald green foam$() appears, run! $(#696969)Do not look back!$()

$(br2)$(#800000)『 Black Alchemist’s Notes 』$()$(br)A scorched fragment of a forbidden text reads:$(br)'Those who consume this $(#8B0000)Demon’s Ichor$(),$(br)shall gain the power to $(#FF0000)tear through the Ender Dragon$(),$(br)and the resilience to $(#DAA520)withstand the Wither’s barrage$()—$(br)but $(#4B0082)every drop of strength$() must be paid for with $(#556B2F)their own flesh$(),$(br)until $(#696969)only bones remain$(), a $(#000000)perfect offering$() to the abyss.'
